Sega PSG: original Tetorica implementation, BSD-3-Clause. See licenses/tetorica_sega_psg/ and sources/SegaPSG.md. Hardware reference: SMS Power! SN76489 documentation by Maxim and contributors.
SNES S-DSP: snes_spc, LGPL-2.1-or-later. See licenses/snes-spc and sources/SNES-SPC.md for source and rebuilding.
Nuked OPN2: LGPL-2.1-or-later. See licenses/nuked-opn2/ and sources/Nuked-OPN2.md for corresponding source and rebuilding.
JavaScript import parser: es-module-lexer 3.0.3, MIT. See vendor/es-module-lexer-LICENSE.

Browser Git: isomorphic-git and bundled dependencies. See js/tetorica_virtual_files/GIT_LICENSES.txt.

NES APU: JSNES, Apache-2.0. See licenses/jsnes/.
FDS: fixNES-derived, MIT. See licenses/fixnes-fds/.
The default NES/FDS WASM uses the shared C++ port. See licenses/tetorica-nes/ and sources/NES-FDS.md for source and rebuilding.

DX7: tetorica-msfa-dx7-wasm 0.3.1 / Google MSFA, Apache-2.0.
See js/msfa_dx7/LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and README.vendor.md.

32X PWM: MAME-derived FIFO/timer core, BSD-3-Clause. See licenses/mame-32x-pwm/.

Game Boy DMG APU: MAME adaptation, BSD-3-Clause. See licenses/mame-gameboy/.

Atari POKEY sound: BSD-labeled libvgm/MAME POKEY adaptation, BSD-3-Clause. See licenses/libvgm-pokey/ and sources/POKEY.md.
CD-DA PCM: original Tetorica C11 implementation, BSD-3-Clause, distributed by the fixed sound-chip SDK. See licenses/tetorica-cdda/ and sources/CDDA.md for copyright, complete source and standalone rebuilding.
MSM5205 PCM and PC Engine ADPCM RAM helper: BSD-3-Clause, adapted from the existing libvgm-based JavaScript renderer and distributed by the fixed sound-chip SDK. See licenses/tetorica-msm5205/ and sources/MSM5205.md for copyright, complete source and standalone rebuilding.
WonderSwan sound: MAME adaptation by Wilbert Pol and kyorohiro, BSD-3-Clause. See licenses/mame-wonderswan/.
PC Engine HuC6280 PSG: MAME adaptation by Charles MacDonald, BSD-3-Clause. See licenses/mame-huc6280/.
X68000 OKIM6258 ADPCM: MAME adaptation by Barry Rodewald, BSD-3-Clause. See licenses/mame-okim6258/.
AY-3-8910 / YM2149 PSG (MSX / Atari ST): MAME adaptation, BSD-3-Clause. See licenses/mame-ay8910/.

RF5C164: MAME adaptation, BSD-3-Clause.
See ./licenses/mame-rf5c164/LICENSE and README.md.

This package includes two YM2612 engine options:

- Default engine: ymfm
  - Project: https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm
  - License: BSD 3-Clause
  - Covered by: ./LICENSE

- Optional engine: Nuked-OPN2
  - Project: https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPN2
  - License: GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 or later (LGPL-2.1-or-later)
  - Included license files:
    - ./licenses/nuked-opn2/LICENSE
    - ./licenses/nuked-opn2/README.md
  - Corresponding source and rebuild recipe: ./sources/Nuked-OPN2.md
